Leadership

Meet the team shaping NAARAD

NAARAD combines AI systems, accessibility, and India-first operational design to build intelligence that adapts to real-world environments.

Founder & CEO
Aryan Mishra
Aryan Mishra is the Founder and CEO of NAARAD, leading the company’s vision across contextual AI, accessibility, and India-first computing systems.

A Data Science student at the Indian Institute of Technology Madras, his work focuses on building intelligence platforms designed for real-world infrastructure, operational environments, and adaptive human interaction. Through collaborations connected with the Energy Consortium at IIT Madras, he brings a systems-oriented perspective toward institutional compliance, interoperability, and ecosystem-level technological synergy.

Influenced by industry-facing ecosystems including CII-linked logistics and supply-chain networks, Aryan’s approach combines future-forward product thinking with practical deployment realities across India’s diverse infrastructural landscape.

At NAARAD, he focuses on creating context-aware interfaces and AI-native systems optimized for accessibility, operational clarity, and India-first user experience design.
Data Lead
Himanshu Jha
Himanshu Jha leads Data and Intelligence Systems at NAARAD, bringing extensive experience in enterprise analytics, AI strategy, customer intelligence, and large-scale digital transformation.

Over the course of his career, he has led data organizations responsible for building scalable machine learning systems, analytics platforms, and decision-support infrastructures across digital-first enterprises. His expertise spans predictive intelligence, data architecture, operational analytics, and enterprise AI adoption.

At NAARAD, Himanshu oversees the intelligence backbone powering contextual reasoning and adaptive environmental understanding. His work focuses on transforming fragmented operational, spatial, and behavioral signals into structured, actionable intelligence systems capable of scaling across complex real-world environments.

He plays a key role in shaping the company’s long-term AI roadmap and ensuring that NAARAD’s intelligence systems remain robust, adaptive, and enterprise-ready.
Product Lead
Sandeep Mishra
Sandeep Mishra leads Product Strategy and User Experience at NAARAD, bringing deep experience across enterprise products, operational systems, fintech platforms, and digital transformation initiatives.

His expertise lies in translating sophisticated technological capabilities into intuitive and deployable user experiences. Throughout his career, he has worked across product strategy, ecosystem design, customer workflows, and platform scaling — helping organizations bridge technological complexity with operational usability.

At NAARAD, Sandeep focuses on designing interaction systems optimized for contextual assistance, accessibility, and real-world deployment across diverse infrastructural environments.

His work ensures that NAARAD’s intelligence systems remain seamless, scalable, and deeply human-centered.

Our Philosophy

NAARAD is built on the belief that the future of computing will move beyond screens toward context-aware intelligence embedded into everyday environments.

Our leadership combines expertise across AI systems, institutional-scale data infrastructure, operational intelligence, and product execution to build technologies that function across complex real-world ecosystems.

Together, we are building adaptive intelligence systems designed for accessibility, infrastructure-awareness, and India-first deployment at scale.

Platform Features

Everything heritage exploration needs

Built for the 40% of India without reliable internet, and every curious traveller beyond.

Smart-cached vector maps deliver full navigation without signal. Heritage corridors load completely before you leave connectivity — no surprises in the field.

News & Updates

What's new at Naarad

Sprint milestones, partnership news, and platform updates — straight from the team.

Sprint Update

NAARAD PWA Live on Google Play Store — Week 1 Sprint Complete

The NAARAD Progressive Web Application has been published on the Google Play Store, establishing our primary distribution channel. Initial user validation on the IIT Madras campus route has yielded positive testimonials, with users highlighting the geofence-triggered audio, hidden vantage points discovery, and heritage storytelling quality. The offline-first architecture leverages service workers and smart caching to deliver heritage navigation experiences in areas with poor connectivity — addressing the 40% of rural India without reliable internet.

📅 May 2026·👤 Aryan Mishra, Founder·⏱️ 4 min read

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 28 June 2026

1. Who We Are

Naarad is operated by the NAARAD Navigational AI Analytics Research & Development Initiative, Chennai, India. Contact: privacy@naarad.io.

2. Information We Collect

  • Account data: Name, email, and encrypted password when you register.
  • Usage data: Pages visited, routes planned, quests completed — collected via analytics in anonymised form.
  • Location data: Only when you activate navigation. Never stored server-side without consent.
  • Payment data: Processed exclusively by Razorpay. Naarad never stores card numbers.
  • Device data: Browser, OS, screen resolution for performance optimisation.

3. How We Use Your Information

  • To provide and improve the Naarad service and personalise route recommendations.
  • To process payments for Explorer and Creator subscriptions.
  • To send transactional emails. No marketing emails without explicit opt-in.
  • To comply with legal obligations under the Indian IT Act 2000 and DPDP Act 2023.

4. Data Sharing

We do not sell personal data. We share data only with Supabase (auth/database), Razorpay (payments, PCI DSS Level 1), and OpenStreetMap (map tiles — no personal data). Legal process may compel disclosure.

5. Your Rights (DPDP Act 2023)

  • Right to access, correct, and erase your personal data.
  • Right to data portability (export as JSON).
  • Right to withdraw consent at any time.

Submit requests to privacy@naarad.io. We respond within 30 days.

6. Security

All data is transmitted over HTTPS/TLS 1.3. Passwords are hashed with bcrypt. Database is encrypted at rest.

7. Contact

Data Grievance Officer: Aryan Mishra — privacy@naarad.io

Terms of Use

Last updated: 28 June 2026

1. Acceptance

By accessing Naarad you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the Platform.

2. User Accounts

  • You must be 13 years or older to create an account.
  • You are responsible for the security of your credentials.
  • One account per person. Bot or shared accounts will be terminated.

3. Acceptable Use

You agree not to reverse-engineer, scrape, or resell Naarad's content; upload false or harmful content; circumvent payment or geofencing systems; or harass other users.

4. Subscriptions and Payments

  • Free tier: 3 heritage trails per month.
  • Explorer (₹49/month): Unlimited trails, offline maps, quest unlocks.
  • Creator (₹199/month): All Explorer features plus route creation tools and 70% revenue share.
  • Subscriptions auto-renew. Cancel anytime. No refunds for partial months.

5. Intellectual Property

All Naarad branding, AI models, and software are property of the NAARAD Initiative. Heritage site information is derived from publicly available records and ASI data.

6. Limitation of Liability

Routes are for informational purposes only. Naarad is not liable for injuries or loss arising from following suggested routes. Maximum liability is limited to subscription fees paid in the preceding 3 months.

7. Governing Law

These Terms are governed by the laws of India. Disputes shall be resolved by arbitration in Chennai, Tamil Nadu under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act 1996.

8. Contact

legal@naarad.io

Accessibility Statement

Last updated: 28 June 2026

Naarad is committed to making heritage exploration accessible to everyone. We are working toward WCAG 2.1 Level AA conformance.

Current Status

  • Screen reader support: In progress — ARIA labels being added across all components.
  • Keyboard navigation: Partially implemented; full support in next release.
  • Colour contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 ratio on all primary text.
  • Audio narration: Available in all routes for visually impaired users.
  • Text size: Respects system font-size preferences.

Known Gaps

  • Interactive map has limited keyboard access — a text-based alternative list view is available.
  • Video content does not yet include closed captions.

Feedback

Contact access@naarad.io — we aim to respond within 5 business days.
